Name: Seven-Star Platform
Notes / Warnings: Wave-based combat training arena within the Skyreach Sect.

Name: Array of Corporeal Brilliance
Notes / Warnings: Designed by Master Robert for Blackrock Peak outer disciples. Body tempering array.

Name: House Solomon
Notes / Warnings: Weaponsmithing house. Famous for needle and concealed weapons masters. Ingrid's extended circle.

Name: Vulture Peak
Notes / Warnings: One of the Thirty-Three Peaks. Home of some competitors.

Name: Shadow Group
Notes / Warnings: Skyreach Sect's secretive assassin division. Johanson is a member.

Name: Cloud Hall
Notes / Warnings: Higher organization above the Skyreach Sect. 'Core disciple' rank used (unique to Cloud Hall).

Name: Demon Night
Notes / Warnings: Non-human entities introduced in Eps 299-300. The Cobalt Dragon describes them. New content.

Name: Castermere County
Notes / Warnings: Zane's home region. Seat of House Lowell. Five powerful families: Hawthorne, Stone, Carter, Hill, Blackwood. Zane returns for revenge in Eps 326+.

Name: Lowell Manor
Notes / Warnings: Ancestral home of House Lowell. Bryson's seat of power. Blood Prisoner kept in cellar. Zane reclaims it.

Name: Silversun Hall
Notes / Warnings: Prince Ray's grand hall. Setting for banquets, political maneuvering, and fight challenges.

Name: Imperial Palace
Notes / Warnings: Royal residence. Isla under house arrest here. Zane infiltrates to rescue her.

Name: Crescent Building
Notes / Warnings: Building in Castermere County where the five lords conspire against Zane.

Name: House Hawthorne
Notes / Warnings: Most powerful family in Castermere County. Lord Chuck. Son Darcy killed by Zane. Rose to power by absorbing House Lowell's wealth.

Name: House Stone
Notes / Warnings: Second most powerful in Castermere County. Lord Ford killed Zane's father Milo. Ford forced to compensate and punished.

Name: House Carter
Notes / Warnings: One of five powerful Castermere County families. Seized Lowell property after Milo's death.

Name: House Hill
Notes / Warnings: One of five powerful Castermere County families.

Name: Seven-Star Platform
Notes / Warnings: Finn's training location at the Skyreach Sect. Refines swordplay and builds raw strength.

Name: Cloud Road
Notes / Warnings: Multi-stage trial dimension opened by Cloud Hall for new disciples. Tests Weaponsmithing skills and combat. Contains: Sea of Raging Fire, cliff challenges, Hidden Tests, Death Road, Thrilling Icy Plain, Sixth-Grade Sect ruins. Entered via gateway powered by Supreme Vitality crystals.

Name: Sea of Raging Fire
Notes / Warnings: Major zone within the Cloud Road. Lava sea with stone pillars. Contains Red Fire Snakes, inferno rays, and rising lava tides. Multiple platforms serve as rest points.

Name: Death Road
Notes / Warnings: Hidden trial within the Cloud Road. Far more dangerous than the Life Road. Contains separate dimensional spaces accessed via energy vortexes. Home to Nether Phantoms, Sky-Reavers, Karmafire, and the Drake puppet. Only the bravest disciples attempt it.

Name: Thrilling Icy Plain
Notes / Warnings: Fourth stage of the Cloud Road. Icy terrain. Frank defeats three opponents here.

Name: Sixth-Grade Sect Ruins
Notes / Warnings: Hidden island within the Death Road. Blood-red enchanted barrier. Contains stone terrace, main hall, herbal garden, treasure storage. Guarded by the Drake puppet and Fiery Dragon Spirit. Tia and Zane explore together.

Name: Crimson Sect
Notes / Warnings: Grade Two sect under Cloud Hall, based in the Heartlands. Led by Eddy Warrick. Stronger than Skyreach Sect due to Heartlands resources. Disciples wear crimson robes. Their competition is The Crimson Crucible.

Name: Duskfall Sect
Notes / Warnings: Sect participating in the Cloud Road Trial. Adler and Randy are members. Adler placed third in The Crimson Crucible.

Name: Luminous Sect
Notes / Warnings: Grade Two sect under Cloud Hall. Led by Lady Sigmund. Lois is a top disciple. Connected to Frank via Lois's betrothal.

Name: Providence Sect
Notes / Warnings: Sect participating in the Cloud Road Trial. Lewis Bailey is their star pupil. Their Leader is present at the Scrying Slate.

Name: The Crimson Crucible
Notes / Warnings: The Crimson Sect's equivalent of the Skyreach Sect's All Peaks Competition. Alistair placed first, Adler placed third.

Name: World Merchants' Guild
Notes / Warnings: Most powerful neutral force in Heartlands. On par with sixth-grade sect. Controls 70% of vitality mines, 80% of commerce. Three Alliance Chiefs: Kieran, Hobbes, Burns. Hosts Martial Tournament. NOT "Void Spirit Sect."

Name: Ethereal Spirit Sect
Notes / Warnings: Most powerful sect in Heartlands. Fifth-grade. Septuplets are core members. Brent is saint/divine-level. NOT "Ethereal Spirit Order" or "Void Spirit Sect." Possesses Soul Flag (Relic-Class).

Name: Bloodwood Cliff
Notes / Warnings: Fourth-grade sect led by Lady Darkmere. Dark arts, forbidden techniques. Soul-Killing Poisoned Blood.

Name: Black Mountain Order
Notes / Warnings: Fourth-grade sect led by Raven. NOT "Black Mountain Sect." Canonical name: Black Mountain Order.

Name: Mysterious Luna Hall
Notes / Warnings: Fourth-grade sect. Led by Elder Luna (~976 years old). Oldest sect in region. Vicious, cruel fighting style. Neither Righteous nor Evil Faction.

Name: Quarryheart Sect
Notes / Warnings: Third-grade sect. Located near supreme Aether crystal mine. Wealthy.

Name: Dragonfall Palace
Notes / Warnings: Dragon-blooded organization in the upper world. Issues standard Relic-Class equipment. Zane belongs to it as a dragon-blood.

Name: Oracle City
Notes / Warnings: Major city in the Heartlands. Location of Dragon Soar Arena and Martial Tournament. World Merchants' Guild headquarters.

Name: Dragon Soar Arena
Notes / Warnings: Ancient arena connecting to the Upper World. Relocated to Oracle City. Only Zane can activate its teleportation array. Grand prize of Martial Tournament.

Name: Martial Tournament
Notes / Warnings: Decennial tournament hosted by World Merchants' Guild. Dragon Soar Arena is the grand prize. No rules against killing. Pre-qualifying matches required for non-sect fighters.

Name: Sacred Mount Lodestone
Notes / Warnings: Mountain deep within the Chaotic Ocean of Stars. Origin of the lodestone test material.

Name: Serenity Palace
Notes / Warnings: Destroyed palace in the Arctic Lands. Holy Maiden's former seat. Source of the Heavenly Feather Crown.

Name: Celestial Tomb of Vesper
Notes / Warnings: Immortal's resting place. Requires nine Enchanted Lamps to open. Treasure inside. Tia and Kieran each have a lamp.

Name: Fleecy Downs
Notes / Warnings: Training area where Owen discovered a treasure hoard from an extinct order.

Name: Union of Seven Divine Kingdoms
Notes / Warnings: Ancient alliance that fought the Dragon-blooded. Three kingdoms destroyed by True Dragon's breath. Four survive today.

Name: Chaotic Ocean of Stars
Notes / Warnings: Vast, dangerous realm. Sacred Mount Lodestone located here. NOT "Chaotic Astral Ocean."
